name: hermes-ego
description: Hermes Ego reads and saves pages from the user's ego(lite) browser through a loopback MCP relay. The Mac daemon and the relay are installed separately.

relay_token.label: Relay token
relay_token.description: Bearer token for the loopback relay. Same value as EGO_RELAY_TOKEN on the relay. Hermes stores it in the profile .env.
